target_questions.question: Does RT instability organize bag, bag-stamen, and multimode breakup in the studied supersonic-flow Weber range?
target_questions.target_basis: Tier 1 C007/C025 provide multiscale and shock-Mach anchors; this paper supplies a supersonic-flow RT interpretation.

evidence_candidates.claim_text: The coupled compressible/incompressible simulations reproduce bag, bag-stamen, and multimode breakup and attribute morphology across the studied Weber range primarily to Rayleigh-Taylor instability.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: Interface-resolved supersonic-flow cases vary Weber number while preserving Ohnesorge context.

core_links.shared_parameter_or_mechanism: shock/supersonic loading controls piercing and breakup morphology

limitations: Numerical method, reduced density-ratio strategy, and the tested Weber range bound the RT interpretation.
visual_verification: Targeted visual verification performed where numeric/glyph-dependent abstract claims required it; no figure digitization.
